title: Integrity
definition: Integrity is wholeness of character in which belief, speech, conduct, and private life are brought under the truth of God.
summary: Integrity is wholeness of character in which belief, words, private conduct, and public life agree before God.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is perfectly true and faithful, and He forms His people to walk in sincerity before God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Integrity is wholeness of character before God, where belief, speech, and conduct are not divided. Scripture calls believers to honesty, faithfulness, and uprightness when seen and unseen.

Integrity does not mean sinless perfection. It means refusing a double life and bringing hidden places under the lordship of Christ.

Jesus is perfectly true, faithful, and undivided. His people are called to walk in the light because they belong to Him.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Hidden compromise slowly destroys trust, witness, and spiritual health. Integrity corrects the lie that private sin is harmless if public image remains intact.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Invite God to search the unseen parts of your life. Tell the truth, keep commitments, repent of secret compromise, and seek accountability where your public and private life are drifting apart.
